data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: neovim
edge_embedded.summary: Neovim是Vim的现代化分支，旨在解决传统编辑器在可扩展性和用户体验上的局限。它通过引入一流的Lua API和嵌入式语言运行时，让开发者能用现代工具链构建高性能插件，这种架构设计使得编辑器核心与扩展功能彻底解耦。你可以用Lua编写自定义编辑命令，集成语言服务器协议实现智能代码补全，或将其作为库嵌入其他应用创建专属编辑环境，这种模块化思路值得任何软件项目借鉴。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Neovim is a modern fork of Vim designed to overcome legacy limitations by enhancing extensibility and usability. Its key innovation is a first-class Lua API and embedded language runtime, enabling developers to build powerful plugins with modern tooling. You can extend it via Lua scripts for custom editing workflows, integrate with LSP servers for intelligent code completion, or embed it as a library in other applications to create tailored editing environments.

edge_embedded.name: PaddleOCR
edge_embedded.summary: PaddleOCR是一个开源OCR工具包，能将PDF和图像转换为结构化文本数据，解决文档与AI模型间的格式鸿沟问题。它采用轻量级架构和多阶段优化技术，在支持100多种语言的同时保持高效识别精度，其核心设计通过分层处理平衡了速度与准确性。用户可通过Python接口快速集成，应用于文档解析、多语言翻译或知识信息提取等场景，为构建自动化文档处理流程提供可靠基础。
edge_embedded.summary_en: PaddleOCR is an open-source optical character recognition toolkit that converts PDFs and images into structured text data, bridging visual documents with language models. Its technical strength lies in a lightweight architecture with multi-stage optimization, achieving high accuracy while maintaining efficiency across 100+ languages. Developers can integrate it via Python APIs for document parsing, translation, or knowledge extraction tasks, enabling practical applications like automated document processing and RAG systems.

agents_workflows.name: TaxHacker
agents_workflows.summary: TaxHacker是一款自托管的AI会计应用，旨在通过自动化处理收据、发票和交易数据，帮助用户和小型企业简化财务管理工作。它利用大型语言模型的可定制提示功能，智能识别交易类别、提取关键信息并支持多币种换算，其核心设计在于将通用AI能力与具体会计规则灵活结合。用户可本地部署以保障数据隐私，根据自身需求调整分析逻辑，并将其应用于日常记账、税务申报或跨境业务等实际场景，实现高效精准的财务分析。
agents_workflows.summary_en: TaxHacker is a self-hosted AI accounting application that automates financial data processing for individuals and small businesses, eliminating manual entry of receipts and invoices. It leverages large language models (LLMs) with customizable prompts to intelligently categorize transactions, extract key details, and handle multi-currency conversions. Users can deploy it locally for privacy, tailor analysis rules to their needs, and integrate it with existing financial workflows to streamline tax preparation and expense tracking.

agents_workflows.name: Skills
agents_workflows.summary: Skills是一个GitHub仓库，包含一系列用于提升开发效率的Shell脚本和命令行工具集。该项目通过模块化设计将常用开发任务自动化，提供可灵活组合的实用脚本组件。开发者可以将这些脚本集成到日常工作中，自动化重复性操作，或通过修改现有脚本来扩展功能。这些工具既可作为即用型解决方案，也可作为学习Shell编程和自动化实践的参考示例，帮助用户构建个性化的开发工具链。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Skills is a GitHub repository containing a collection of shell scripts and command-line utilities designed to enhance developer productivity through automation. deployment_serving.name: neovim
deployment_serving.summary: Neovim是Vim的现代化分支，旨在解决传统编辑器在可扩展性和用户体验上的局限。它通过引入一流的Lua API和嵌入式语言运行时，让开发者能用现代工具链构建高性能插件，这种架构设计使得编辑器核心与扩展功能彻底解耦。你可以用Lua编写自定义编辑命令，集成语言服务器协议实现智能代码补全，或将其作为库嵌入其他应用创建专属编辑环境，这种模块化思路值得任何软件项目借鉴。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Neovim is a modern fork of Vim designed to overcome legacy limitations by enhancing extensibility and usability. Its key innovation is a first-class Lua API and embedded language runtime, enabling developers to build powerful plugins with modern tooling. You can extend it via Lua scripts for custom editing workflows, integrate with LSP servers for intelligent code completion, or embed it as a library in other applications to create tailored editing environments.

deployment_serving.name: TaxHacker
deployment_serving.summary: TaxHacker是一款自托管的AI会计应用，旨在通过自动化处理收据、发票和交易数据，帮助用户和小型企业简化财务管理工作。它利用大型语言模型的可定制提示功能，智能识别交易类别、提取关键信息并支持多币种换算，其核心设计在于将通用AI能力与具体会计规则灵活结合。用户可本地部署以保障数据隐私，根据自身需求调整分析逻辑，并将其应用于日常记账、税务申报或跨境业务等实际场景，实现高效精准的财务分析。
deployment_serving.summary_en: TaxHacker is a self-hosted AI accounting application that automates financial data processing for individuals and small businesses, eliminating manual entry of receipts and invoices. It leverages large language models (LLMs) with customizable prompts to intelligently categorize transactions, extract key details, and handle multi-currency conversions. Users can deploy it locally for privacy, tailor analysis rules to their needs, and integrate it with existing financial workflows to streamline tax preparation and expense tracking.

framework_core.name: PaddleOCR
framework_core.summary: PaddleOCR是一个开源OCR工具包，能将PDF和图像转换为结构化文本数据，解决文档与AI模型间的格式鸿沟问题。它采用轻量级架构和多阶段优化技术，在支持100多种语言的同时保持高效识别精度，其核心设计通过分层处理平衡了速度与准确性。用户可通过Python接口快速集成，应用于文档解析、多语言翻译或知识信息提取等场景，为构建自动化文档处理流程提供可靠基础。
framework_core.summary_en: PaddleOCR is an open-source optical character recognition toolkit that converts PDFs and images into structured text data, bridging visual documents with language models. Its technical strength lies in a lightweight architecture with multi-stage optimization, achieving high accuracy while maintaining efficiency across 100+ languages. Developers can integrate it via Python APIs for document parsing, translation, or knowledge extraction tasks, enabling practical applications like automated document processing and RAG systems.
